snippet.title: Parasensor | Frosty Games Fest 2025
snippet.description:
Featured in Frosty Games Fest 2025! Watch the full showcase here: https://youtu.be/3ff3YxX7Cgw

We are extremely excited to premiere the incredibly vibe-y Announcement Trailer for Parasensor from Ghoulish! Parasensor is a fixed-camera, horror mystery with gameplay mechanics involving conversation, deduction, and environmental exploration. Players will take on the role of Marisol Mendez, a telecom technician living inside a cordoned city, where its citizens are undergoing a frightening metamorphosis.

Wishlist on Steam

Find more games made in Australia and Aotearoa New Zealand on our Steam event page here: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45423962/sale/FrostyGamesCelebration
